gloss: to put on top; to cover; to place over

definitions.gloss: to cover, to put over, to place on top
definitions.explanation: To place something over or on top of something else so as to cover it.

definitions.gloss: to put (a hat, etc.) on someone; to make someone wear
definitions.explanation: To place a hat, hood, or similar item on someone else's head.
To make someone else bear the responsibility or blame for something.

examples.japanese: {鍋|なべ}にふたを{被|かぶ}せる。
examples.english: Put a lid on the pot.

examples.japanese: {寝|ね}ている{子|こ}に{毛布|もうふ}を{被|かぶ}せた。
examples.english: I put a blanket over the sleeping child.

examples.japanese: ケーキにチョコレートを{被|かぶ}せて{仕上|しあ}げた。
examples.english: I finished the cake by coating it with chocolate.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}に{帽子|ぼうし}を{被|かぶ}せた。
examples.english: I put a hat on the child.

examples.japanese: {赤|あか}ちゃんにフードを{被|かぶ}せてから{外|そと}に{出|で}た。
examples.english: I put the hood on the baby before going outside.

examples.japanese: {犬|いぬ}にサンタの{帽子|ぼうし}を{被|かぶ}せて{写真|しゃしん}を{撮|と}った。
examples.english: I put a Santa hat on the dog and took a photo.

examples.japanese: {責任|せきにん}を{人|ひと}に{被|かぶ}せるな。
examples.english: Don't shift the blame onto others.

examples.japanese: {自分|じぶん}の{失敗|しっぱい}を{部下|ぶか}に{被|かぶ}せた。
examples.english: He shifted his own failure onto his subordinate.

examples.japanese: {罪|つみ}を{被|かぶ}せられて、{無実|むじつ}なのに{逮捕|たいほ}された。
examples.english: He was framed with the crime and arrested despite being innocent.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
- Pair: {被|かぶ}る (intransitive, to wear/to be covered)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ふたを{被|かぶ}せる: to put a lid on
- {毛布|もうふ}を{被|かぶ}せる: to put a blanket over
- {帽子|ぼうし}を{被|かぶ}せる: to put a hat on (someone)
- {責任|せきにん}を{被|かぶ}せる: to shift blame onto
- {罪|つみ}を{被|かぶ}せる: to frame someone

NUANCE: {被|かぶ}せる is the causative-like transitive form of {被|かぶ}る. While {被|かぶ}る means to wear or be covered oneself, {被|かぶ}せる means to put something over someone/something else.
